# tools-todo

The Todo list tool (todo_write): the session's todo list.

- **Runs in:** the harness process
- **Source:** [lisp/modules/harness-tools-todo.el](../../lisp/modules/harness-tools-todo.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md)

## About

`todo_write` replaces the session's todo list, which the session
shows: its items pending, in progress or done.

## Provides

### Tools

- `todo_write` — Replace the session's todo list. Each item has id, text and status (pending, in-progress or done); plain strings are accepted as pending items. Keep exactly one item in progress at a time and mark items done as soon as they are.

## Uses

### Methods it calls

- `session/set-todos` ([session](session.md))
